ns2:section.sectionText: This is a U.S. history survey that starts with the pre-Columbian period (prior to 1492) and continues on to Reconstruction, after the Civil War. It emphasizes primary source readings and social and cultural approaches to understanding the past. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionDegreeAttributes: Discovery, Hist&Philosoph Perspect, and Western Compartv Cult course.
